issues.claim: "the company's QC posting lists QCS/RMS familiarity as a plus" (current_tools, sourced to the SimplyHired listing)
issues.problem: The cited SimplyHired page does not mention QCS or RMS anywhere. The QCS/RMS 'BIG PLUS' line appears in a different Benaka posting, on the company's own careers page (which also differs: 'daily Production Reports', RFIs 'in coordination with Project Manager'). The fact is true of Benaka's advertising but the citation points at a page that does not contain it.
issues.fix: Re-source the QCS/RMS claim to https://www.benakainc.com/careers.html, or cite both postings separately (careers page for QCS/RMS + purchase orders, SimplyHired for the $100k-$140k range and the combined QC Manager/Project Superintendent title).

issues.claim: "A live listing ... on a third-party job board ... [the role] manage[s] the three phases of control ... write RFIs with the superintendent, prepare purchase orders, and complete daily QC reports"
issues.problem: This blends two different Benaka postings. The SimplyHired listing (the only URL cited) has no 'prepare purchase orders' duty and says RFIs are written 'in coordination with Project Superintendent'. The 'Prepare Purchase orders prior to ordering any material' duty and the 'QCS/RMS' line come from benakainc.com/careers.html, which is not cited.
issues.fix: Attribute the purchase-order and QCS/RMS duties to the careers-page posting; keep the salary range and combined title on the SimplyHired citation. Both postings are real, so no number changes.

issues.claim: "the client has real contract value behind it (a $134M-ceiling Air Force MACC and a 2026 USACE MATOC)" (feasibility.reasoning)
issues.problem: No source URL is given, and third-party federal award databases describe the $134M as the ceiling of a shared multiple-award vehicle (FA4484-20-D-0005) on which Benaka holds a place, not Benaka-specific value; a 2025 recompete MACC is reported at a $300M shared ceiling. The 2026 USACE MATOC (New England District, ~$90M shared ceiling) is supported but also uncited in the plan.
issues.fix: Add the HigherGov/GovTribe award-record URLs and reword to 'holds a place on a MACC whose reported ceiling is $134M (shared across awardees) and joined a USACE small-business MATOC in 2026'.

issues.claim: "Contact page lists phone, fax, email and a contact form" (current_tools)
issues.problem: The contact page renders phone, fax, email and an employee OWA link, plus a 'Subcontractors/Vendors ... contact us by phone, email, or contact form' sentence, but no form element is present in the page markup.
issues.fix: Reword to 'phone, fax, email and an employee webmail (OWA) link; no portal, booking or document-exchange channel is published'.
